verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly define the SKILL.md format (name + description frontmatter, optional scripts/references), and provide tooling (@plugin-creator, skill-installer, recorder) that scaffolds new skills without needing to reverse-engineer existing ones; a probe confirms real install producing valid SKILL.md frontmatter. missing for 10: no independent hands-on account of writing a SKILL.md purely from the template without any tooling assistance, and no example of the full documented template content itself.
